_comment: Factory orchestrator policy (spine AD-7). backend: interactive (default, native Workflow launch) | claude-headless (native CLI) | opencode (integrated server dispatcher, independent build leases) | dry (read-only scheduler suggestions). autoApply stays false: humans author commits (KI-E1).
_buildCapacity: OpenCode backend maps this to dispatcher buildConcurrency: filesystem leases cover Node mechanics and worker commands using build-lease.mjs. Native interactive/claude-headless backends report advisory only. Arbitrary shell commands are not intercepted.

claudeHeadless.promptTemplate: Operate as the AI-factory worker plane. Launch the Workflow tool on the script at {runScript} with NO args, wait for it to complete, then reply DONE. Do not run any git commands. Do not edit any file outside the per-item worktrees the script names.
